{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for converted customers (converted == 1)
converted_customers = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out sentinel value -1 in customer_age
valid_converted_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = valid_converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Check the number of valid converted customers
num_valid_converted = len(valid_converted_customers)

# Print both the mean and the count to confirm
print(f"Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age_converted}")
print(f"Number of valid converted customers: {num_valid_converted}")"}
